name: Colour grade
description: A before/after wipe: flat, log-like footage on one side, a cinematic grade on the other, and a divider with a handle that sweeps across, then leaves the frame graded.
when: When you talk about the look of a video, editing or colour, or to make a plain shot feel produced.
needs: the cut time and length of the moment
optional: the before and after label text
